paragraphs.en: scriptc compiles TypeScript and JavaScript to native executables and WebAssembly. It uses the types checked by the TypeScript compiler to generate machine code, and the output runs without Node.js installed. npm packages your program imports compile along with it. Code scriptc can't compile is reported at build time with a diagnostic and, where available, a rewrite hint.
paragraphs.zh: scriptc 将 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 编译为原生可执行文件和 WebAssembly。 它使用 TypeScript 编译器检查的类型来生成机器码，输出的程序无需安装 Node.js 即可运行。程序导入的 npm 包也会一并编译。 scriptc 无法编译的代码会在构建时以诊断信息的形式报告出来，并在可能的情况下提供改写提示。

sents.en: scriptc compiles TypeScript and JavaScript to native executables and WebAssembly.
sents.zh: scriptc 将 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 编译为原生可执行文件和 WebAssembly。

sents.en: It uses the types checked by the TypeScript compiler to generate machine code, and the output runs without Node.js installed. npm packages your program imports compile along with it.
sents.zh: 它使用 TypeScript 编译器检查的类型来生成机器码，输出的程序无需安装 Node.js 即可运行。程序导入的 npm 包也会一并编译。

sents.en: Code scriptc can't compile is reported at build time with a diagnostic and, where available, a rewrite hint.
sents.zh: scriptc 无法编译的代码会在构建时以诊断信息的形式报告出来，并在可能的情况下提供改写提示。

paragraphs.en: scriptc is experimental and supports a subset of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js APIs. Run scriptc coverage on an existing program to see how much of it compiles, and see the limitations and Node.js compatibility reference for details.
paragraphs.zh: scriptc 是实验性的，支持 JavaScript、TypeScript 和 Node.js API 的一个子集。 在现有程序上运行 scriptc coverage，查看其中有多少可以编译通过，详情请参阅限制说明和 Node.js 兼容性参考。

sents.en: scriptc is experimental and supports a subset of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js APIs.
sents.zh: scriptc 是实验性的，支持 JavaScript、TypeScript 和 Node.js API 的一个子集。

sents.en: Run scriptc coverage on an existing program to see how much of it compiles, and see the limitations and Node.js compatibility reference for details.
sents.zh: 在现有程序上运行 scriptc coverage，查看其中有多少可以编译通过，详情请参阅限制说明和 Node.js 兼容性参考。

paragraphs.en: Install with Node.js 24 or later and npm:
paragraphs.zh: 请安装 Node.js 24 或更高版本以及 npm：

paragraphs.en: $ npm install -g scriptc The installed compiler runs natively on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Node.js is needed only to install it and to run WASI modules with scriptc run . Standalone compiler archives are also available from GitHub Releases .
paragraphs.zh: $ npm install -g scriptc 安装好的编译器可在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上原生运行。 Node.js 仅在安装时以及使用 scriptc run 运行 WASI 模块时才需要。 独立编译器压缩包也可以从 GitHub Releases 获取。

sents.en: $ npm install -g scriptc The installed compiler runs natively on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
sents.zh: $ npm install -g scriptc 安装好的编译器可在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 上原生运行。

sents.en: Node.js is needed only to install it and to run WASI modules with scriptc run .
sents.zh: Node.js 仅在安装时以及使用 scriptc run 运行 WASI 模块时才需要。

sents.en: Standalone compiler archives are also available from GitHub Releases .
sents.zh: 独立编译器压缩包也可以从 GitHub Releases 获取。

paragraphs.en: Building executables requires a linker and the platform SDK or sysroot. See the quickstart for prerequisites and platform support for host requirements, cross-compilation, and WebAssembly.
paragraphs.zh: 构建可执行文件需要链接器以及平台 SDK 或 sysroot。 有关前提条件请参阅快速入门，有关主机要求、交叉编译和 WebAssembly 请参阅平台支持。

sents.en: Building executables requires a linker and the platform SDK or sysroot.
sents.zh: 构建可执行文件需要链接器以及平台 SDK 或 sysroot。

sents.en: See the quickstart for prerequisites and platform support for host requirements, cross-compilation, and WebAssembly.
sents.zh: 有关前提条件请参阅快速入门，有关主机要求、交叉编译和 WebAssembly 请参阅平台支持。

paragraphs.en: const who = process . argv . length > 2 ? process . argv [ 2 ] : "world" ; console . log ( `hello, ${ who } ` ) ; scriptc run compiles the file and runs the result:
paragraphs.zh:
```js
const who = process . argv . length > 2 ? process . argv [ 2 ] : "world" ; console . log ( `hello, ${ who } ` ) ;
```

`scriptc run` 会编译该文件并运行结果：

paragraphs.en: $ scriptc run hello.ts hello, world scriptc build writes an executable:
paragraphs.zh: $ scriptc run hello.ts hello, world scriptc build 会生成一个可执行文件：

paragraphs.en: $ scriptc build hello.ts -o hello > /dev/null $ ./hello scriptc hello, scriptc These examples use POSIX shell syntax. On Windows, build hello.exe and run it with .\hello.exe .
paragraphs.zh: $ scriptc build hello.ts -o hello > /dev/null $ ./hello scriptc 你好，scriptc 这些示例使用 POSIX shell 语法。 在 Windows 上，构建 hello.exe 并用 .\hello.exe 运行它。

sents.en: $ scriptc build hello.ts -o hello > /dev/null $ ./hello scriptc hello, scriptc These examples use POSIX shell syntax.
sents.zh: $ scriptc build hello.ts -o hello > /dev/null $ ./hello scriptc 你好，scriptc 这些示例使用 POSIX shell 语法。

sents.en: On Windows, build hello.exe and run it with .\hello.exe .
sents.zh: 在 Windows 上，构建 hello.exe 并用 .\hello.exe 运行它。

paragraphs.en: Use scriptc coverage hello.ts to check what compiles before you build. See coverage reports for details.
paragraphs.zh: 在构建之前，使用 scriptc coverage hello.ts 检查哪些内容可以编译通过。 详见覆盖率报告。

sents.en: Use scriptc coverage hello.ts to check what compiles before you build.
sents.zh: 在构建之前，使用 scriptc coverage hello.ts 检查哪些内容可以编译通过。

paragraphs.en: Supported Node APIs compile to the native runtime. For example, server.ts :
paragraphs.zh: 受支持的 Node API 会编译为原生运行时。例如，server.ts：

paragraphs.en: import { createServer } from "node:http" ; const server = createServer ( ( req , res ) => { res . setHeader ( "content-type" , "application/json" ) ; res . end ( JSON . stringify ( { path : req . url } ) ) ; } ) ; server . listen ( 8080 , ( ) => { console . log ( "listening on http://localhost:8080" ) ; } ) ; $ scriptc build server.ts -o server > /dev/null $ ./server listening on http://localhost:8080 Use npm packages npm packages compile into the executable with your code, so it doesn't read node_modules at runtime.
paragraphs.zh: import { createServer } from "node:http" ; const server = createServer ( ( req , res ) => { res . setHeader ( "content-type" , "application/json" ) ; res . end ( JSON . stringify ( { path : req . url } ) ) ; } ) ; server . listen ( 8080 , ( ) => { console . log ( "listening on http://localhost:8080" ) ; } ) ; $ scriptc build server.ts -o server > /dev/null $ ./server listening on http://localhost:8080 使用 npm 包 npm 包会与你的代码一起编译进可执行文件中，因此在运行时不需要读取 node_modules。

paragraphs.en: import pc from "picocolors" ; console . log ( pc . green ( "hello from scriptc" ) ) ; $ npm install picocolors $ scriptc build cli.ts -o cli > /dev/null $ ./cli hello from scriptc Package support is partial. See npm dependencies for which packages compile and how to check them.
paragraphs.zh: import pc from "picocolors" ; console . log ( pc . green ( "来自 scriptc 的问候" ) ) ; $ npm install picocolors $ scriptc build cli.ts -o cli > /dev/null $ ./cli 来自 scriptc 的问候 包支持是部分的。 参见 npm 依赖部分，了解哪些包可以编译以及如何检查它们。

sents.en: import pc from "picocolors" ; console . log ( pc . green ( "hello from scriptc" ) ) ; $ npm install picocolors $ scriptc build cli.ts -o cli > /dev/null $ ./cli hello from scriptc Package support is partial.

sents.en: See npm dependencies for which packages compile and how to check them.
sents.zh: 参见 npm 依赖部分，了解哪些包可以编译以及如何检查它们。
